newsitem.title: USA: GPU International in venture with AstroPower.
newsitem.headline: GPU International in venture with AstroPower.

text.p: GPU International and AstroPower Inc said Tuesday they have formed a joint venture company, called GPU Solar, to make and sell solar electric photovoltaic systems for the residential market.
Photovoltaic systems collect the suns' rays and transfers them into energy.
The units will be designed to connect to existing utility distribution systems and will have sufficient battery storage to power critical household loads during electrical interruptions.
GPU International, whose parent company is GPU Inc, will provide $300,000 of working capital for the venture.
AstroPower, a private company, will produce the solar modules and assemble the pre-engineered systems for shipping.
GPU International said it has also been awarded $250,000 of U.S. Department of Energy funds from the utility Photovoltaic Group, a national organization of utilities.
The company said GPU Solar will use the money to cut the price of the first 72 kW of PV systems sold to consumers.
GPU Solar will be targeting the home building industry.
